title: Robust issue-URL parsing with GitHub Enterprise support
plan:
Add robust GitHub issue URL parsing with InvalidIssueUrlError, wire Octokit baseUrl for Enterprise hosts, validate and normalize issue URLs in task creation/retry endpoints, and add unit tests for parseIssueUrl.
1. Implement robust parseIssueUrl, InvalidIssueUrlError and Octokit baseUrl handling in GithubApi
2. Validate and normalize issueUrl in POST /api/task and POST /api/task/:taskId/retry, return 400 for InvalidIssueUrlError and store normalized URL
3. Add Vitest unit tests for parseIssueUrl covering >=10 cases
requirements: Export class InvalidIssueUrlError extends Error from backend/src/GithubApi/index.ts
parseIssueUrl(url) in backend/src/GithubApi/index.ts returns { host, owner, repo, issueNumber }
parseIssueUrl accepts https://github.com/o/r/issues/12 with optional trailing slash, ?query and #fragment
parseIssueUrl accepts www.github.com and any host listed in comma-separated env GITHUB_HOSTS
parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError for URLs containing /pull/ (pull requests)
parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError for non-numeric or zero issue numbers
parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError for unknown hosts (not github.com, www.github.com, or one of GITHUB_HOSTS)
parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError for http:// (non-https) URLs
parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError for owner/repo names containing characters GitHub forbids
Octokit client in backend/src/GithubApi/index.ts uses baseUrl: https://<host>/api/v3 when host is an enterprise host (i.e., not github.com or www.github.com)

POST /api/task (backend/src/api/router.ts) returns 400 { error: <message> } when validation fails due to InvalidIssueUrlError and stores the normalized URL (https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>) when creating taskRegistry/db entries and when enqueuing
POST /api/task/:taskId/retry (backend/src/api/router.ts) returns 400 { error: <message> } for InvalidIssueUrlError and normalizes stored issueUrl similarly when updating registry from body.issueUrl
Add Vitest tests at backend/src/GithubApi/__tests__/parseIssueUrl.test.ts covering at least 10 accepted/rejected cases
summary:
Implemented robust GitHub issue URL parsing and validation, added InvalidIssueUrlError, configured Octokit for enterprise hosts, normalized issue URLs in API endpoints, and added unit tests.

What changed:
- backend/src/GithubApi/index.ts
  - Exported class InvalidIssueUrlError extends Error.
  - Implemented parseIssueUrl(issueUrl) returning { host, owner, repo, issueNumber } with strict validation: only https, allowed hosts (github.com, www.github.com, and process.env.GITHUB_HOSTS entries), rejects /pull/ URLs, non-numeric/zero issue numbers, and invalid owner/repo names. Accepts trailing slash, query, fragment. Added setupOctokitForHost to set Octokit baseUrl to https://<host>/api/v3 for enterprise hosts and updated methods to call it.
- backend/src/api/router.ts
  - POST /api/task: validates the provided issueUrl using GithubApi.parseIssueUrl, returns 400 { error } for InvalidIssueUrlError, normalizes and stores the URL (https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>) when registering the task, in DB create, and when enqueuing.
  - POST /api/task/:taskId/retry: validates and normalizes body.issueUrl similarly and returns 400 for InvalidIssueUrlError.
- backend/src/GithubApi/__tests__/parseIssueUrl.test.ts
  - Added Vitest tests covering 11 cases: standard URL, trailing slash, query/fragment, www host, enterprise host via GITHUB_HOSTS, and rejected cases for unknown host, http protocol, pull URLs, non-numeric/zero issue numbers, and invalid owner/repo names.

How verified:
- Compiled TypeScript (cd backend && npx tsc -b) and fixed type issues introduced.
- Ran backend tests (cd backend && npm test) — all backend tests passed (78 tests).

Assumptions and notes:
- process.env.GITHUB_HOSTS is a comma-separated list of allowed enterprise hosts.
- Owner/repo validation uses regexp /^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/ which is conservative and rejects characters GitHub disallows in common cases.
- Normalized URL format is https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>.
